initialFindings: The selected creator candidate had an overly stocky trunk, pointed dorsal snout outline, broad pectoral envelope and coarse atlas grain.
An alternative static candidate included human/bubble decoration, a pale baleen-like surface and unresolved exact texture-source scopes; it was not admitted.
A first private raw-bind-space edit truncated the rostrum and distorted the flipper envelope; rejected, then corrected in actual neutral posed space with inverse-skin rebinding.
Material front-face culling was rejected; the creator double-sided material is retained.
changes: Runtime external-shape derivative: a narrower selected trunk, rounder dorsal rostrum and shorter pectoral envelope, two smooth subdivision passes in posed space with inverse-skin rebinding and interpolated atlas coordinates/weights. The source base atlas has a disclosed 2.2-pixel Gaussian smoothing and saturation factor 0.75; two other source image payloads and all source animation accessors remain unchanged. Cool-grey material modulation and reduced normal strength are authored. These are not specimen-fitted dimensions or measured optical properties. Selected eye exteriors are reduced to 0.6 of their prior diameter and use a dark material in place of the conspicuous amber iris patch; these are unmeasured choices.

motion.label: Fluke and flipper study
motion.description: The same corrected textured surface and retained creator skeleton play a finite fluke/flipper excerpt at half the source speed, then hold. Playback seconds, joint excursions and phasing are unmeasured. It does not model a swimming trajectory, fluid thrust, energetic cost, feeding or respiration. Observe holds the first creator frame, avoiding a discontinuous switch from the raw bind pose.
motion.evidence: Species-specific qualitative locomotion context and retained creator excerpt; no fitted trajectories
motion.timeScale: uncalibrated display seconds; half source speed; finite 8.167-second excerpt

rendering.reason: Same credited corrected surface and skeleton; no fitted real-animal kinematics, full trajectory or hydrodynamics.

motion.label: Lunge feeding mechanism
motion.description: Krill engulfment uses opening jaws, an extensible ventral pouch and subsequent filtration through baleen. This interaction is not reconstructed.
motion.evidence: Documented species behaviour; no complete prey/pouch/filtration mechanism in the viewer

rendering.reason: Prey, oral cavity, pouch expansion and filtration are incomplete; the fluke excerpt is not labelled as feeding.

assessment.identity: Accepted species-rank agreement of GBIF/MDD/WoRMS plus source-captioned NOAA photographs; no independent redetermination of model/photo.
assessment.shape: Selected exterior improved; no individual morphometric fit.
assessment.texture: Smoothed artist atlas and approximate lighting; not photographic skin reconstruction or measured optics.
assessment.movement: Finite half-speed creator excerpt, not calibrated full swimming or physiological simulation.

remaining: Body, rostrum, flipper and fluke proportions are selected, not fitted to an identified individual or subspecies.
Source pigment is an artist atlas with disclosed smoothing/colour modulation; natural variation, wet optics, scars and epibionts remain incomplete.
Ventral pleats, paired blowhole rims, eyelids, selected eye proportions and internal mouth/baleen anatomy need further geometric reconstruction.
The finite creator-derived excerpt is not a complete swimming/feeding/breathing or biomechanical controller; no measured amplitude, period, force or physiological validation.
Final software compatibility images cannot validate WebGL normal maps, wet specular response or refraction.
